clarification.rule: M10B arm history materializes an upstream post-M10B-start S1/S3/S4 candidate only after its native M9V branch EXIT is resolved. Open upstream candidates are not inserted early into resolved performance history.
clarification.entry_reconstruction: After native EXIT resolves, entry acceptance is deterministically reconstructed using only the bars/features that were fully closed and knowable at the original entry/reclaim decision. The native EXIT outcome/value is never an input to entry eligibility.
clarification.reason: Preserve resolved-only live reproducibility and avoid early insertion of unresolved outcomes while reusing the exact M10A deterministic payoff implementation.
clarification.runner_exception: After native EXIT resolves, a runner arm can remain OPEN if its causal runner exit has not occurred yet. That open runner blocks later entries in the same arm under one-position accounting and is not included in resolved PF/WR until its runner exit resolves.
